key.name: current-npub
key.description: The selected public identity; independent of Gnostr's active identity.

key.name: signer-method
key.description: One of auto, local, nip46, or nip55l. This build only reports whether the org.nostr.Signer service is reachable for auto, local and nip55l; nip46 is unsupported and nothing is signed.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Reserved for a future notification service; disabled in this shell.

key.name: notification-privacy
key.description: One of hidden, sender, or preview; hidden is the privacy-preserving default.

key.name: sound-enabled
key.description: Reserved for a future notification service.
